prohibitions: No status file can mark work complete without an integrated validated receipt.
The implementation control plane is not the product runtime.
No role, worker, or dispatcher may expand authority.
No same-model role label may be presented as an independent human.
No human escalation may substitute for a software repair or role-resolvable question.
ChatGPT Classic is the default node owner; Codex may be used only for the smallest proven unavailable execution capability after Classic/tool/role paths are exhausted.
Never ask the user for a manual action without novice-safe exact instructions and proof that genuine human authority or access is required.

target.baseline_rule: The baseline must remain an ancestor. Any target advancement must be reconciled before new claims.
